accepted.message: command ["git","push"] with --force | -f | --mirror | +* anywhere: commandPrefix matches the start of the command, so only the flag right after the words is denied, not the flags anywhere later in it
accepted.reason: Gemini runs only the evaluator, whose forge token is read-only, so a force push spelled any way fails at the forge; shell redirection into .git/hooks is refused by the product's hook deny
